answer: Reserve the summit for agents that keep walking. Give every identity a sable coat of collateral that only thins when its owner is caught signing two histories in one epoch; a season of clean work returns it intact. Thread each registration onto a public loom, so a new name must weave into an existing one, and a loom that spins a thousand threads from a single spool reads as one cloth. Payouts follow the length of the thread, not the count of knots. A farm can buy silence in bulk; it cannot buy a summit it never climbed.
